versions.changelog:
- Provides secure, credential-free access to API-SPORTS through the OOMOL `oo` CLI.
- Uses live connector schemas to validate action inputs and outputs before requests.
- Supports football fixtures, events, lineups, statistics, predictions, standings, injuries, leagues, players, teams, squads, and top scorers.
- Covers schedules and performance data across matches, leagues, teams, and players.
- Includes guidance for authentication, connection setup, billing errors, and execution IDs.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@75bac03`

- Provides an OOMOL-backed API-SPORTS connector skill for football data access without handling raw API tokens.
- Supports fixture schedules, scores, live status, events, lineups, match statistics, and predictions.
- Covers league, team, player, squad, injury, standings, team statistics, and top-scorer lookups.
- Uses `oo connector schema` before execution so payloads match the live action contract.
- Documents safe read-only behavior plus first-time setup guidance for CLI, auth, connection, and billing errors.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@146ef20`

- Initial release of the API-SPORTS skill for accessing football data through an OOMOL-connected `api_sports` account.
- Provides 14 read/search actions for leagues, teams, squads, players, fixtures, standings, injuries, predictions, lineups, events, and match statistics.
- Supports fixture discovery by match, league, team, date, live status, or time range, including schedules and scores.
- Enables season-level football analytics such as standings, team statistics, player statistics, and top scorers.
- Uses the `oo` CLI with server-side credential injection, so raw API tokens are not handled by the skill user.
